geoLocationId.description: Geo Location Id of the scan. Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/lookup-items?type=GeoLocations

dynamicScanEnvironmentFacingType.description: Type of environment the server is running in

dynamicScanAuthenticationType.description: This field is obsolete. Please use the hasFormsAuthentication field to indicate if Forms Authentication is required to scan the site

hasFormsAuthentication.description: True if Forms Authentication is required to scan the site

primaryUserPassword.description: Primary account password to login with

secondaryUserPassword.description: Secondary account password to login with

otherUserName.description: Other username needed to operate the site

otherUserPassword.description: Other password needed to operate the site

requiresNetworkAuthentication.description: True if network connection is required to scan the site

notes.description: Additional notes that will help with running a scan

timeZone.description: The timezone. Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/lookup-items?type=TimeZones

blockout.description: Blockout days list. All days and hours will default to checked unless otherwise specified.

repeatScheduleType.description: For scans that are to be run at regular intervals, this specifies how often

assessmentTypeId.description: Assessment type identifier of the scan. Values can be obtained by calling GET /api/v3/releases/{releaseId}/assessment-types

allowFormSubmissions.description: True to allow form submissions (default), otherwise false..

restrictToDirectoryAndSubdirectories.description: True to restrict to directory and subdirectories, otherwise false

generateWAFVirtualPatch.description: True to generate WAF virtual patch, otherwise false

isWebService.description: True if this a web service scan

postmanCollectionURL.description: URL for the remote Postman collection manifest

openApiURL.description: URL for the remote OpenApi manifest

remoteManifestAuthorizationHeaderName.description: Optional header name for downloading a remote manifest (e.g. Postman, OpenApi)

remoteManifestAuthorizationHeaderValue.description: Optional header value for downloading a remote manifest (e.g. Postman, OpenApi)

networkName.description:
When set indicates that the scan should use the specified Fortify on Demand Connect
network when running the scan. Scans that use a Fortify on Demand Connect network
will automatically set dynamicScanEnvironmentFacingType to 'Internal'. Fortify on
Demand Connect must be enabled for this tenant to use this feature.

graphqlUrl.description: URL for the remote GraphQL manifest

apiSchemeType.description: Api scheme type (e.g. Http or Https or HttpHttps)

apiHost.description: Api host name or Ip address with port number

apiServicePath.description: Directory path for the API service

twoFactorAuthentication.description: Gets or sets the two-factor authentication settings

day.description: Day of week the hour blocks are associated with

hourBlocks.description: The list of hours and their blockout states

checked.description: Checked is true when this hour is blocked out. It is false when clear to scan

value.description: URL fragment to exclude from scanning.
URL subdomain to include in scanning.
